name: Case study: piston rings, published limits 74 ± 0.05 mm

reference.note: Published limits: the process is very capable (Cp ≈ 1.7), so Optimise barely moves the mean. Inside diameter of forged piston rings (qcc pistonrings, Montgomery 1991), mm. σ = 0.00986 is the pooled within-sample sd of samples 1–25; the Mean Setting 74.0012 is their mean, the current process. Costs, the Rework Side (undersize bore re-machined) and the rework model are hypothetical. See case_studies/piston_rings.
